article_title: Why we bought our first home with a 100% mortgage - despite the risks

tasks.prompt: Which statement best captures the article's message about low-deposit mortgages?
options: They can help buyers unable to save deposits but involve costs and risks
They remove all risks associated with falling house prices
They are available to every borrower and property
They always cost less than mortgages with larger deposits
tasks.correct_answer: They can help buyers unable to save deposits but involve costs and risks
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכתבה מציגה אפשרות לרוכשים שמתקשים לחסוך לצד ריבית גבוהה וסיכונים.

tasks.prompt: Why did Bronya and George choose a small deposit despite having more savings?
options: They were required to give the rest to Lloyds
They wanted to retain money for renovations
Their home could not be renovated
They planned to sell immediately
tasks.correct_answer: They wanted to retain money for renovations
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הזוג שמר חסכונות לפרויקט שיפוץ שעלותו מעל 20,000 ליש״ט.

tasks.prompt: What is “negative equity” as defined in the report?
options: Rent costing more than repayments
A lender refusing any loan
A property's value being below the outstanding mortgage debt
Paying off a mortgage early
tasks.correct_answer: A property's value being below the outstanding mortgage debt
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הון עצמי שלילי נוצר כאשר שווי הנכס נמוך מהחוב שנותר.

tasks.prompt: What does “get on the housing ladder” mean here?
options: Move to a taller building
Renovate a roof
Become a mortgage broker
Begin owning a home
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הביטוי מתאר כניסה לבעלות על דירה או בית.

tasks.prompt: What do Conroy and Amber plan to do to build equity?
options: Overpay their mortgage during the first five years
Stop making payments when prices fall
Increase their loan to cover holidays
Sell before making any repayments
tasks.correct_answer: Overpay their mortgage during the first five years
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הם מתכננים לשלם מעבר להחזר הנדרש בחמש השנים הראשונות.

tasks.prompt: What does George mean by being prepared to “ride out” market dips?
options: Predict every price change
Stay in the home through temporary falls in property values
Avoid making monthly repayments
Replace the fixed rate every month
tasks.correct_answer: Stay in the home through temporary falls in property values
tasks.explanation_hebrew: הכוונה היא להישאר בבית ולצלוח ירידות בשוק, בהתאם לתכנון לטווח ארוך.

tasks.prompt: What payment history must applicants demonstrate for Skipton's zero-deposit mortgage?
expected_points: Rent paid for at least 12 consecutive months
Credit payments maintained for the last six months
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לציין את שתי תקופות התשלום ואת סוג התשלום המתאים לכל אחת.

tasks.prompt: Why might negative equity be especially painful for a borrower who suddenly needs to sell?
expected_points: The sale price may be lower than the remaining debt
A low or zero deposit leaves less protection against price falls
The borrower may face a shortfall after selling
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש להסביר את הפער האפשרי בין תמורת המכירה לחוב, לא לטעון שהוא ודאי.

tasks.prompt: Summarise the benefits, safeguards and risks of today's low-deposit mortgages in this report.
expected_points: Smaller upfront deposits help some first-time buyers
Interest rates tend to be higher
Affordability checks are stronger than before the 2008 crisis
Falling prices can create negative equity
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לאזן יתרונות, בדיקות זכאות וסיכונים ולייחס את ההשוואה ל־2008 למומחה.

tasks.prompt: Using the report, write a balanced explanation of why the two couples accepted the risks. Do not give personal financial advice.
expected_points: Conroy and Amber could not save a deposit while renting
They expect rising salaries and plan overpayments
Bronya and George retained savings for renovations
They plan to stay long term
tasks.rubric_hebrew: יש לכתוב הסבר באנגלית עם פרטים משני הזוגות ולהימנע מהמלצה אישית.
